settings.text: A few minutes of care keeps leather supple and suede rich for years. These are the rituals we follow at the Maison.

settings.heading: Before first wear
settings.row_content: Apply a suede protector spray from 20 cm away and let it dry for 24 hours. This guards the suede overlays against water and stains.

settings.heading: Leather
settings.row_content: Wipe with a soft, dry cotton cloth after wear. Every few months, apply a small amount of neutral leather cream, let it absorb, then buff gently.

settings.heading: Suede
settings.row_content: Use a soft suede brush, always in one direction, to lift the nap. For marks, use a suede eraser. Never use water or leather cream on suede.

settings.heading: Midsoles & laces
settings.row_content: Clean midsoles with a damp cloth and mild soap. Laces can be removed and hand-washed in lukewarm water, then air-dried.

settings.heading: Storage
settings.row_content: Insert cedar shoe trees, keep the pair in its dust bag, and store away from direct sunlight and heat. Let shoes rest a day between wears.

settings.heading: Repairs & questions
settings.row_content: Write to us with your pair's serial (printed under the QR tag) and we will advise on care or repair.
